baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction اتخذتم ... أوثانا مودة بينكم joins deliberate idol-taking to affection located in the space between the group.
baseline_models.mechanism: The idols function as acquired social infrastructure: shared worship gives mutual affection a durable object and a visible center. The ثم reversal turns connection into reciprocal disavowal, partition, and expulsion, so the same arrangement that joins the group also contains its eventual fracture.

activation_trace.role: Acquiring or making something one's own supplies the deliberate installation of the cultic object as social infrastructure.
The worshipped image supplies the concrete common object around which the group gathers.
Strength and persistence explain the stabilizing durability attributed to that common object.
Love and mutual affection supply the positive force holding the worshippers together.
A connection standing between parties turns affection into a relational bond rather than a private feeling.
Disavowal and withdrawal reverse the earlier attachment into reciprocal repudiation.
Repeated parts of a whole make the former collective break into mutually opposed fractions.
Expulsion under anger turns relational fracture into active exclusion from good.

changed_reading.before: The ayah condemns a group for worshipping idols and predicts that its members will quarrel in the hereafter.
changed_reading.after: The ayah diagnoses idolatry as a deliberately built social bond: the shared object stabilizes belonging for a time, then the bond's own members disown and expel one another.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The explicit span في الحياة الدنيا ثم يوم القيامة places affection on one side of a temporal threshold and reciprocal rejection on the other.
baseline_models.mechanism: Dunya is the near and lower horizon in which the arrangement works, while the day of rising is a severe event that makes every party stand. Affection is therefore not simply weak sentiment; it is a relation calibrated to one limited time-world and unable to cross the evaluative threshold.

activation_trace.role: The near and lower world supplies the restricted horizon within which the affection remains effective.
A day as a severe event supplies the disruptive threshold that tests the bond.
Resurrection and the standing of creatures supply the new condition under which the relation is evaluated.
Desire for something to obtain exposes an interested dimension within the worldly attachment.
Mutual renunciation marks the affection's failure to survive its original temporal setting.

changed_reading.before: Worldly friendship happens to end when judgment begins.
changed_reading.after: The idol-mediated affection is structurally time-bounded: it is fitted to the near world's interests, and the act of standing for judgment removes the conditions that made it work.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The close مأواكم النار وما لكم من ناصرين answers the earlier taking of substitutes apart from God with an imposed refuge and the absence of helpers.
baseline_models.mechanism: The group acquires lower substitutes and mutual attachment as if they could gather, shelter, and support it. Its actual gathering-place is fire, while the expected network of aid is empty; a self-chosen refuge becomes an inescapable anti-refuge.

activation_trace.role: A substitute other than and lower than the true referent supplies the displaced source of protection.
Joining a place that gathers and shelters supplies the spatial logic of the final destination.
The kindled fire supplies a refuge whose material function destroys rather than protects.
Aid that gives victory supplies the protective function the substitutes and associates finally cannot perform.

changed_reading.before: The verse adds fire and lack of help as two punishments after the social quarrel.
changed_reading.after: The ending completes a protection-system reversal: what was taken as a sheltering alliance yields an anti-shelter, and the mutual support embodied in the alliance proves nonexistent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The parental scene locates pressure toward association with God inside a relation where kindness and obedience carry exceptional weight. This revises مودة بينكم from spontaneous warmth into a channel through which a cult reproduces loyalty: affection can be real while also being used to demand conformity.

activation_trace.role: Real affection supplies the social force that can be converted into pressure.
The connection between parties supplies the pathway along which loyalty demands travel.
Driving someone to the limit of hardship supplies the intensity of familial pressure toward cultic compliance.
Parenthood supplies a binding relation whose claims are emotionally and socially difficult to refuse.
Association with God identifies the precise cultic conformity demanded through that relation.
Obedient submission supplies the behavioral outcome that the pressure seeks and the ayah limits.

structural_cues: 29:8 preserves good treatment of parents while explicitly refusing their demand for cultic obedience.
The focus ayah names affection between people, not merely attachment to the objects.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies kinship, strenuous pressure, shirk, and refused obedience; I infer that affection can transmit cult loyalty. A live alternative is that this is a special family conflict rather than a general mechanism of idol groups.

changed_reading.before: The group's affection is merely a pleasant by-product of common worship.
changed_reading.after: The affection is also a governance mechanism: intimate bonds make demands for cultic conformity effective even when the affection itself remains genuine.

context_deltas.mechanism: The invitation to follow a path comes with a promise to carry the followers' errors, then an immediate denial that the promisers can carry them. The focus bond now reads as a moral risk-sharing compact; reciprocal disavowal and cursing are the settlement crisis when promised surety fails, even while instigators still acquire added burdens for their influence.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal renunciation supplies the failure of the earlier undertaking between group members.
The repeated fractions identify both sides of the failed compact as pieces of one former coalition.
Contradiction of truth classifies the offered transfer of liability as a false assurance.
A liability that follows and adheres supplies the moral consequence attached to following the group's path.
Surety and guarantee supply the promisers' proposed social contract for absorbing another's errors.
Bearing a trust or burden supplies the actual accountability retained by the misleading party.
Weight makes both personal and added liabilities tangible rather than transferable speech.

structural_cues: 29:12 pairs follow our path with we will carry your errors, then denies the proposed carrying.
29:13 preserves both own burdens and additional burdens before the same resurrection day named in the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a following-demand, a carrying promise, its denial, and added burdens; I read these as a failed surety arrangement. The promise may be rhetorical rather than juridical, but its risk-transfer logic remains active.

changed_reading.before: The associates simply fall out because each wants to escape punishment.
changed_reading.after: Their mutual repudiation is the collapse of a cultic liability compact: followers discover that belonging did not transfer responsibility, while leaders discover that influence added weight rather than absorbing it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The first statement about the same idols denies their power to own any provision and redirects seeking and gratitude. This activates a material layer in مودة بينكم: the shared cult may organize reciprocity, patronage, or expectations of livelihood, while the objects at its center own none of what sustains the network.

activation_trace.role: The worshipped object anchors the same cultic institution discussed in the preceding passage.
Affection supplies the interpersonal reciprocity maintained around the institution.
Fabricating false speech supplies the invented account that legitimates the cultic arrangement.
Possession and power of disposal identify the capacity explicitly denied to the worshipped objects.
Allotted provision supplies the material good that the objects cannot control and worshippers are redirected to seek.
Active seeking relocates material dependence away from the idol network.
Recognizing a benefit and its giver relocates gratitude away from the social-cultic arrangement.

structural_cues: 29:17 repeats worship of idols apart from God and immediately frames the issue through ownership and provision.
The focus follows within the same Abraham discourse and changes from provision to the affection maintained among worshippers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated idols, denied ownership, provision, seeking, and gratitude; I infer that material reciprocity helps sustain the affection. A live alternative is that provision is solely theological evidence and not a description of the group's economy.

changed_reading.before: The idols hold people together only through shared symbolism.
changed_reading.after: The cultic bond can also be read as a provision network: social reciprocity clusters around objects credited with efficacy even though they possess and distribute nothing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, the coalition answers dissent by ordering killing or burning, and God extracts Abraham from their fire. The next ayah assigns fire as their own مأوى. The instrument used to police group solidarity becomes the group's imposed destination, making refuge language sharply ironic.

activation_trace.role: A place that gathers and shelters supplies the ironic destination assigned to the aggressors.
The kindled fire supplies the destructive material that is recast as their refuge.
Deliverance by separation removes Abraham from the destination his opponents tried to impose.
Taking life supplies the first collective proposal for enforcing the cult's boundary.
Flame supplies the coalition's chosen enforcement instrument.
The same fire image links Abraham's rescue directly to the focus group's final anti-refuge.

structural_cues: 29:24 and 29:25 are adjacent, with fire closing the first and returning as the group's refuge in the second.
The plural group that proposes burning is addressed through plural possession and reciprocal actions in the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attempted burning, rescue from fire, and the next ayah's fire-refuge; I infer a directed reversal from imposed weapon to imposed destination. The two occurrences can still denote distinct fires at the literal level.

changed_reading.before: Fire is only a later punishment unrelated to the group's treatment of Abraham.
changed_reading.after: Fire is a reversed social instrument: the coalition tried to make it the dissenter's end, but the same material becomes the coalition's own shelterless end.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later simile repeats taking apart from God, pairs it with protective allies, and repeats taking for the spider's house. This gives the focus's مودة بينكم a material topology: the idol is a node in a web-like house of relations. It can be intricate and connective yet structurally unable to shelter, which explains both the final absence of helpers and the replacement of refuge by fire.

activation_trace.role: Mutual affection supplies the strands connecting members of the social structure.
A connection standing between parties gives those strands an interstitial relational form.
Affection joined to protective alliance makes the later allies functionally continuous with the focus bond.
A deliberately presented simile authorizes the house as a model for the taken alliances.
The web-making spider supplies the agent whose construction is connective but not protective.
A house as shelter supplies the protective function claimed by the social-cultic structure.
A household and its members extend the simile from a physical shelter to a social unit.
Loss of force identifies the structure's inability to protect despite its visible connectedness.
Repeated making or acquisition joins the worshippers' chosen allies to the spider's self-made house.

structural_cues: 29:41 repeats the focus sequence اتخذوا من دون الله and then repeats اتخذت for the spider's house.
The simile evaluates a house specifically by weakness, matching the focus's failed refuge and absent aid.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated taking, allies, spider, house, and weakness; I map the focus's between-space to a web-like relational architecture. The simile may primarily target protective efficacy rather than the internal texture of affection, so the web mapping is an abductive extension.

changed_reading.before: The idols are isolated false objects and the friendships around them are incidental.
changed_reading.after: The idols are load-bearing nodes in a social web-house: the network is excellent at connecting insiders but incapable of bearing the protective load for which it was taken.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later, the same between-root marks God as sufficient witness between speaker and audience, while belief in the false and denial of God are judged. The private between-space occupied by cultic affection becomes an observed forum. Reciprocal disavowal at resurrection can therefore be read as failed testimony and accusation inside a relation that was never outside witness.

activation_trace.role: The connection between parties supplies the social space initially occupied by mutual affection.
Standing over an affair until sufficiency supplies a witness who needs no support from the group's consensus.
The interval between opposing parties relocates the root from intimate connection to an adjudicative relation.
Presence with observation makes the between-space witnessed rather than socially sealed.
Loss of truth and stability identifies the object around which the earlier consensus formed.
Concealing or denying truth supplies the charge that the witnessed forum resolves.

structural_cues: 29:52 repeats بين twice in a witness formula, against the focus's بينكم.
The ayah immediately contrasts attachment to falsehood with denial of God, preserving the focus's allegiance problem.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated between-language, a sufficient witness, falsehood, and denial; I infer a shift from social interior to judicial forum. A live alternative is that بين is merely a common relational preposition without thematic force.

changed_reading.before: Between you denotes only the group's private field of affection.
changed_reading.after: Between you is also a field of accountability: the bond operates before a witness, and its final mutual accusations expose what group consensus had concealed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later exact phrase الحياة الدنيا is classified as diversion and play, while the later abode is called the actual life. This does not void every worldly affection; it specifically reframes the focus's idol-mediated affection as game-bound social currency. Its roles and payoffs disappear when the game-world ends, so the eschatological reversal is structural rather than sudden.

activation_trace.role: Affection supplies the social reward circulating among participants in the worldly arrangement.
Life as benefit and good sharpens the contrast between nominal worldly life and the hereafter's effective vitality.
The near world repeats the focus's explicit temporal container for the cultic affection.
Being occupied by one thing away from another makes the social arrangement a diversion from its proper referent.
Action without a sound final purpose supplies a role-system whose internal rewards do not survive its frame.
The later reality supplies the contrasting horizon in which the game-bound bond loses currency.

structural_cues: 29:64 exactly repeats الحياة الدنيا from the focus and contrasts it with the later abode.
The focus itself marks the same transition with ثم before the day of rising.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exact repeated phrase and the diversion, play, and real-life contrast; I infer that idol-mediated affection functions like in-game currency. The claim is limited to this cultic bond, since the packet does not make all worldly love unreal.

changed_reading.before: The affection is authentic but merely short-lived.
changed_reading.after: The affection can be authentic inside a bounded role-system while lacking value beyond it; resurrection ends the game that assigned the idols and alliances their social payoff.

context_deltas.mechanism: At sea, danger strips worship to exclusive invocation of God; rescue to land is followed by renewed association. The secure sanctuary and surrounding seizure sharpen the pattern. The focus's worldly affection is thus a bond reconstructed under ordinary safety, while exposed helplessness temporarily removes its intermediaries and previews the final absence of supporters.

activation_trace.role: Aid and victory supply the protective capacity whose absence the crisis episodes expose.
Embarking upon and bearing a dangerous undertaking supplies the crisis condition.
The vessel moving through water supplies a setting where ordinary social protections cannot secure survival.
Exclusive separation from association supplies the crisis-state removal of cultic intermediaries.
Rescue by release supplies the transition back into ordinary safety.
Renewed association after rescue supplies the reconstruction of the displaced arrangement.
A protected sanctuary supplies the stable environment in which the false security system can persist.
Rapid seizure outside that boundary supplies the surrounding vulnerability hidden by local safety.
Covering a benefit and refusing gratitude identify the reconstruction as denial of the protection actually received.

structural_cues: 29:65 sequences danger, exclusive invocation, rescue, and immediate return to association.
29:67 contrasts protected space with people being seized around it, then names belief in falsehood and denial of divine benefit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies danger, exclusive invocation, rescue, renewed shirk, sanctuary, and surrounding seizure; I infer that ordinary safety lets the social-cultic bond reassemble. The sequence may chiefly diagnose ingratitude, but it also visibly tests the protection mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The idol coalition remains psychologically stable until judgment unexpectedly breaks it.
changed_reading.after: The coalition is already crisis-sensitive: mortal exposure strips away its intermediaries, and only restored safety lets its worldly affection and false protection be rebuilt.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The W-D-D inventory places ordinary affection and Wadd, a named worshipped idol, under one mapped root. It is surprising because the surface مودة is grammatically affection, not the proper name Wadd; it remains anchored by the immediate pairing of idols and مودة. Downstream prose must present this as a lexical fold or echo, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The adjacent focus words أوثانا مودة place an idol class beside a W-D-D noun whose branch inventory also contains a named idol.

activation_trace.role: A worshipped image supplies the explicit idol category beside the W-D-D noun.
Love and affection supply the grammatically active sense of مودة.
Wadd as a named idol supplies a lexical echo that momentarily collapses the distance between affection and cult object.

changed_reading.before: Affection is a social effect entirely separate from the idols that produce it.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory lexical echo, affection itself approaches idol-form: the group not only loves through an idol but can objectify and venerate the bond that joins it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The L-A-N branch of a field effigy is materially distant from the verb يلعن and cannot replace its sense of cursing or expulsion. It remains useful because the focus already juxtaposes worshipped images, an in-group bond, and reciprocal expulsion. Downstream prose should qualify it as a spatial analogy for boundary policing that later turns inward.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus moves from worshipped images and affection between insiders to each part expelling the other through curse.

activation_trace.role: The worshipped image supplies the installed human-like object at the center of the group's boundary.
Affection supplies the positive in-group force maintained inside that boundary.
Connection between parties supplies the interior social field.
An installed field effigy that frightens and drives creatures away supplies a material analogy for exclusionary boundary enforcement.
Fragmentation makes the former insiders become the targets of their own exclusion mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Mutual cursing is only verbal hostility after the bond has vanished.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the cultic image helps constitute an inside by policing an outside; at judgment that expelling function rotates inward and every former insider treats another as the one to be driven out.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The N-W-R branch for نائرة, enmity among a group, is form-distant from the surface النار and must not dilute the literal fire. It remains anchored by the mapped focus root, the immediate mutual disavowal and cursing, and the preceding literal fire. Downstream prose should render it only as a secondary resonance: the final fire materializes the hostility latent in the worldly bond.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places mutual repudiation and cursing immediately before مأواكم النار, all within the same collapsing group.

activation_trace.role: Affection supplies the initial positive relation whose opposite is later exposed.
Expulsion in anger supplies the overt hostility into which the bond turns.
Enmity arising among a group supplies a branch-level resonance between social combustion and the final fire.
The preceding kindled fire keeps the literal material referent primary while enabling the social resonance.

changed_reading.before: The social collapse and the fire are consecutive but functionally separate outcomes.
changed_reading.after: With careful containment, the fire can also be heard as the material completion of a نائرة already ignited between former allies: their refuge is the hostility their bond concealed.

strongest_changes: The same cultic affection becomes a failed moral-surety and provision network, not merely shared sentiment.
The attempted fire used against Abraham reverses into the aggressors' own anti-refuge.
The spider-house simile turns مودة بينكم into an intricate social web that connects well but cannot shelter.
The exact الدنيا contrast and the sea-crisis sequence show that the bond is both time-bounded and crisis-sensitive.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah repetition linked taking, substitutes, allies, carrying, provision, fire, houses, witness, crisis, and refuge back to the focus. The most distinctive branch activations were the Wadd echo inside مودة, the curse-root's expelling effigy, and the fire-root's social enmity.
remaining_uncertainties: The syntax of مودة can support purpose, cause, or an object-like bond; the social-infrastructure reading preserves rather than resolves that openness.
The surety and provision mechanisms are strongly sequenced but remain reader-supplied social arrows rather than explicit institutional descriptions.
The Wadd, field-effigy, and social-enmity outliers are deliberately form-distant and require the stated containment.
